Current: Azahar 2127.0-rc1, locally rebuilt for iOS arm64 and iOS Simulator arm64.

Source: https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar/tree/2127.0-rc1
Unified source archive: https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar/releases/download/2127.0-rc1/azahar-unified-source-2127.0-rc1.tar.xz
SHA-256: 4c966d8344da9a95c2c9ccfc6671991ba3bf36d82157c7d0a64ca25f1d30ed24
License: GPL-3.0-or-later; the exact upstream LICENSE.txt is included.

Build 9 uses upstream FastInterp with CPU/shader JIT disabled, native 1× graphics, 100% CPU clock and the existing per-game accuracy profiles. Prior local DynCom instruction-cache modifications are retired. `patch-azahar.py` retains the required libretro presentation/teardown fixes; the simulator-buffer, queried MoltenVK features, fixed shader stacks, background shader option/wait diagnostics and state-cache patches are ported. Supported null-descriptor features are queried/enabled consistently with the new renderer; unsupported features stay disabled. Both cores retain `-O3 -DNDEBUG -gline-tables-only` and have real matching dSYMs. The original mathematical guest-head generator remains; imported console resources take precedence and are not distributed.

Build 16 adds `Scripts/azahar-async-pipeline-probe.patch`: on Apple platforms, async-eligible draws bypass the synchronous driver-cache probe and use the existing background pipeline worker. Required draws and synchronous mode keep their waits. Driver pipeline-construction calls of at least 20 ms log their duration and cache-probe status. The patch is reproduced by `patch-azahar.py`; both architectures are rebuilt with real matching dSYMs. CPU/shader JIT, emulated clock, accuracy profiles, shader-cache version inputs and snapshot format are unchanged. Physical Dark Moon gains remain unmeasured.

Build 17 adds `Scripts/azahar-player-settings.patch`. The libretro live-option path reapplies existing per-game GPU settings before `ApplySettings`. Opt-in cached-shader preparation reports bounded progress and waits for queued pipelines before play; the default null-callback/background path retains its existing behavior. The native bridge drains pending transfers before live resolution/sampling changes. Both optimized architectures are rebuilt with real matching dSYMs. No CPU clock, JIT, shader accuracy, cache-version or snapshot-format change is introduced. The actual Simulator renderer passes live 3×→1×→2×→3× changes and state restore; new physical-phone performance remains unmeasured.

The 2126.2 cores/source and build-8 archive/source packages are preserved for rollback and comparison. The historical notes below describe those earlier builds and their then-current GPL-2.0-or-later license.

Previous: Azahar 2126.2 official iOS arm64 libretro release.

Source: https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar/tree/2126.2
Archive: https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar/releases/download/2126.2/azahar-libretro-ios-arm64-2126.2.zip
Archive SHA-256: 18e78a721884438b11a3588f96d19e09895f0dbb5c716448343ab185972bc451
License: GPL-2.0-or-later; see LICENSE.txt.

Local simulator and device rebuilds use the unified 2126.2 source release, SHA-256 85c8b56fac703df04720125044b8ff887997911858a6cde545dfb1107ba4cd26. Reproducible source fixes are in Scripts/patch-azahar.py, applied by Scripts/build-simulator-core.sh. The frontend uses Vulkan through MoltenVK. The original official device binary is replaced only after a successful local build.

Build 2 adds coherent shared interpreter decoding, ARM/Thumb cache keys, bounded cache recycling and Info-level core logging. Scripts/prepare-mii-fallback.py changes only the open-source replacement archive's 32×32 error-glyph textures to an original guest face. Its structure and metadata remain unchanged. Nintendo-provided Mii models and personal Mii data are not included; imported console archives take precedence over the fallback. The texture layout is documented by https://github.com/B3n30/citra_system_archives/blob/f470e0c9d341db73b8a24880295d2eab4cd81660/mii/mii-archive-format.md.

Build 4 keeps `-O3 -DNDEBUG` and adds `-gline-tables-only`, generating a matching framework dSYM. This corrects build 3's symbol-upload warning without changing core settings or selecting a Debug build. The archive validator checks UUID identity and real DWARF sections.

Build 5 adds original closed 3D guest-head and hair meshes with a curved facial canvas, generated by `Scripts/prepare-mii-fallback.py` from mathematical geometry. The fallback is generic; console-imported Mii archives retain precedence. No Nintendo models, textures or user console resources are distributed. The generator checks mesh/index bounds, archive layout and idempotence.

`Scripts/azahar-moltenvk-features.patch` enables supported extended dynamic state, fragment interlock and pipeline cache control on the actual Apple Vulkan device using queried feature chains. `Scripts/azahar-save-state-cache.patch` initializes the recreated renderer's live shader caches when restoring a state, fixing the null-cache crash reproduced with Homebrew Menu. Both simulator and device cores were rebuilt in optimized Release mode with matching real dSYMs.

The final build-5 software-shader change replaces three per-run heap-backed stacks with fixed inline storage, retaining Boost circular-buffer overflow behavior. `Scripts/fixed-shader-stack.h`, `Scripts/azahar-shader-stacks.patch` and the patch driver reproduce it. `Tests/shader-stack.cpp` compares reference behavior; optimized-binary inspection verifies that the three allocator calls were removed.

Build 6 adds `Scripts/azahar-shader-stutter.patch`: it exposes the existing Vulkan asynchronous shader option through libretro and logs pipeline waits of at least 20 ms. The app keeps asynchronous compilation disabled by default because new objects can appear late. The updated state-cache patch reapplies the game’s shader profile before loading the recreated renderer’s caches; this prevents the profile mismatch and regeneration reproduced after state restores. CPU/shader JIT, native resolution, CPU clock and multiplication accuracy are unchanged. Both architectures are rebuilt with real matching dSYMs.

## Build21 resource policy

Mandatory Scripts/azahar-no-bundled-resources.patch returns no built-in console keys and removes default HTTP client-certificate/key fallback includes. The derived complete build input replaces the three now-unused data headers with notice-only placeholders; all other pinned upstream source/license files are retained. See Docs/Legal/SANITIZED-UPSTREAM-21.json for original/derived hashes and modifications, and CORE-RESOURCE-POLICY-21.json for exact device/Simulator binary hashes and negative payload checks. Original upstream and earlier binaries/archives remain preserved outside this release. This is a packaging change, not a performance or legal-clearance claim.
